scope: Individual personal non-commercial course project; not a license for public redistribution.
public_git_policy: Only code, aggregate statistics and source hash/storage/recovery metadata. No retained raw or derived IMDb records, names, credits, evaluation evidence or target database.
required_attribution: Information courtesy of IMDb (https://www.imdb.com). Used with permission.

schema_semantics.startYear: Movie release year, not a complete date, territory or guaranteed earliest global premiere.
schema_semantics.principals: Principal cast/crew with source ordering; not complete cast, not starring billing.
schema_semantics.nconst: IMDb person identifier; binds only after source-work and role/name context verification.
schema_semantics.knownForTitles: Limited known-for list; not a complete filmography or sufficient credit evidence.

snapshot_policy: Each archive has its own SHA256, ETag, Last-Modified and publisher x-amz-meta-run-date in acquisition.json; files were not assumed to represent one coherent daily snapshot.
recovery: Download official offered archives, compare each registered SHA256, then import complete gzip streams and retain selected raw rows/offsets. Publisher refresh may change bytes: do not overwrite old version or claim exact historical replay without retained archives. Input change requires a new version work directory.
verification: catalog_statistics.json records full-file EOF/CRC checks and row counts; acquisition-time pending_full_import is an honest earlier state, not a failed final CRC.
